plugins/ravenclaude-core/dashboard.html: P9 wave 1: 12 mechanism inventory entries. Measured cost 34 payload elements per entry against the ~411/concept the Learn tab carries, because an inventory entry ships no mermaid block (the diagrams-opt-in decision, R2 corollary). Projection to a 162-entry corpus is ~5,500 elements, not the ~90,000 the plan feared. Headroom left for wave 2.

P6 adds the verification-strength badge and nuance block to every concept card (~1.8 KB of CSS + markup scaffolding). R12 makes that rendering non-optional: 96 of 162 artifacts get a weak check, and a weak check that renders identically to a strong one is the inert-gate defect wearing a badge.

P9 wave 1: 12 mechanism inventory entries plus their nuance and evidence blocks rendered into the concept cards. 74 KB for 12 entries is ~6 KB each; a 162-entry corpus projects to ~1 MB on this surface, well inside the 8-12 MB the plan warned about, again because no diagrams are rendered.
